title: Signed package envelope, version 1
description: Structure only: required and forbidden members, types, enumerations, string patterns, and length and count limits. A document this schema accepts can still be refused by the engine, because the engine's relational and time-based rules cannot be expressed here; the Python validator in public_pilot is authoritative. Not expressed here: the Ed25519 signature; the trust grant for key_id, its package and author scope and allow_paper; and the non-structural rules of the payload. Authoritative: public_pilot.packages.resolve_chain, run by `public-pilot verify` and `install`.
$comment: Patterns end in $(?!\n) so that regular-expression engines whose $ also matches before a final newline still require a whole-string match. JSON Schema counts 1.0 as an integer; the engine requires integer literals.
